plugins.name: espos-firmware
plugins.description: ESP32 firmware knowledge distilled from building espOS: diagnosing memory budgets (PSRAM that appears to do nothing, which pool TLS really uses), component checks that survive an ESP Component Registry install, and publishing firmware a browser-based flasher can fetch.

plugins.name: espos-dev
plugins.description: Working on espOS and its child repos: which repo owns what and the contracts between them, building and releasing a firmware on espOS, and signing keys, OTA, the registry and fleet updates through signalk-espos-manager.
